title: D-087 PKT-L (proposal-editor phase C2/C3): the PDF sheet import service - closed rings on a chosen page offered as candidates, the USER assigns building outline / property line / street frontage and names one real-world edge length (the scale), and a proposal DRAFT is built through the same validate_proposed_massing contract as the DXF import; pure service, UNMOUNTED
objective: Build app/drawings/sheet_import.py, the PDF counterpart of the accepted DXF import service (app/drawings/dxf_import.py, M5-T108 - the precedent to mirror; READ-ONLY here). Pure: no I/O, no route, no persistence; every failure a typed refusal VALUE, never an exception to the caller. (1) CANDIDATES: given a SheetDocument from read_sheet and a page index, list the page's CLOSED polylines as candidates addressed by their stable polyline index on that page, each with vertex count and measured dimensions in SHEET units (bbox, perimeter, area - reuse dxf_import's public measured_dimensions where it fits); bounded (at most a declared number, largest area first, the total count disclosed); plus a disclosure of what else the page holds (open polylines, text runs, images, the reader's skip counts) and the page's text runs containing the word 'scale' LISTED verbatim (escaped, length-bounded) as reference notes - never parsed into a scale. A page index out of range, or a page with no closed ring, is an honest typed result (the no-closed-ring case says outlines drawn as separate segments are not joined yet). (2) SCALE (the phase-C plan's C2 rule: confirmation against a user-named known dimension): the user names ONE edge of a candidate ring (candidate index + edge index) and its real length in feet; the SERVICE measures that edge on the sheet itself (never a client-supplied measurement); scale = known feet / measured sheet length; finite, strictly positive, bounded, else refused. No architectural-scale menu in this packet (the page's printed scale notes are reference only). (3) DRAFT (C3): the user-assigned building-outline ring, scaled, explicit closure, into a proposed_massing block validated by app.scenario.proposal.validate_proposed_massing exactly as dxf_import.build_draft does (the contract's provenance kind stays 'proposed'); a separate provenance block with input_class 'imported_pdf', the precision label 'imported drawing - not survey-confirmed', the source label 'Proposed - not a city record', the page index, the named edge + known length + measured length + scale, the assigned roles, and a frame note that the outline is in a LOCAL scaled sheet frame, not aligned to the mapped lot (alignment is a later step). Nothing is ever labelled a city record, a permit, approved, or a maximum allowed building; input precision is never upgraded (D-083-R006).
business_reason: The owner wants real architect PDFs to become usable proposals (D-087-R005; the phase-C plan). Three of six real files now read fully (M5-T118); this is the step that turns a read page into a draft building the user confirms, with honest scale and provenance.
